summary: Master GDPR and DPA compliance with hands-on DPIA, breach response, and data mapping training. Ideal for IT, legal, and compliance professionals.
lede: Data protection and privacy governance training helps professionals who manage, process, or oversee personal data govern its handling and reduce privacy risks. Participants learn to map data flows and retention, assess processing risks, and apply safeguards such as access controls and privacy-by-design practices. They also practice handling data subject requests and organizing breach response, connecting privacy principles with operational governance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate professionals who manage, process, or govern personal data within their organizations and need to ensure compliance with GDPR and DPA.
modules: Foundations of Data Protection and Privacy Principles
Lawful Basis and Data Subject Rights Management
Data Mapping, Inventory, and Retention Governance
Risk Assessment and Privacy by Design
Emerging Trends: AI Privacy and Digital Transformation
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of basic IT security concepts and familiarity with organizational data handling processes. No coding or programming skills required. Participants should bring a laptop for hands-on exercises using free/open-source privacy tools. This course is designed for intermediate professionals; beginners should review GDPR Article 4 definitions prior to attendance.
